{{Quote|The Republic Army runs Fort Garnik, but they let the boss do as he pleases. He keeps their supply lines open.|Corso Riggs to a smuggler|<ref name="LandingParty">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Landing Party|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>}}
'''Fort Garnik''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military base located on the island [[Avilatan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

Fort Garnik was the chief base for Republic military forces on Avilatan. It held the command center, as well as a small [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] used to reach orbit. Listening posts, [[Manka-class armored transport|armored transports]], and aerial support units could be found there. Fort Garnik also held a small market, businesses, and a cantina, and during the [[Separatist War]] refugee camps surrounded the fort.

During the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]], Separatist attacks were common. Continuous fighting existed near the base, in an effort to drive the Republic off Avilatan.

During the Cold War, Republic and Mantellian military units garrisoned or temporarily operating out of the fort included the [[45th Infantry Division]],<ref name="TheAmbush">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|The Ambush|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref> [[Ord Mantell Infantry Command]],<ref name="TheSpy">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|The Spy|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref> [[Republic Corps of Engineers/Legends|Republic Corps of Engineers]],<ref name="GeneratorProblems">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Generator Problems|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref> [[Republic Special Forces Division]]'s [[Havoc Squad]],<ref name="HittheGroundRunning">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|Hit the Ground Running|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref> and the [[Thirty-first Recon]].<ref name="SnipeHunt">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Snipe Hunt|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Fort_Garnik.jpg|thumb|250px|Fort Garnik]]
Fort Garnik first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It is the main location for the Republic classes on Ord Mantell, and it can be accessed only by characters belonging to this faction, because the planet is not available on the galactic map for the Empire classes. The fort consists of several quests for the Trooper and Smuggler classes.
